name: Create OLAP partitions
description: Create OLAP partitions for specific datamart table
statement:
/*
Create OLAP partitions for specific datamart table
*/
DECLARE 
	@TableID int,
	@id sysname = ':5',
	@step int = :4,
	@min int = :2,
	@max int = :3,
	@cur int = 0,
	@I int = 1,
	@table sysname,
	@schema sysname

SELECT 
	@TableID = TableID
FROM
	CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS
WHERE
	TransformationID = :1 AND
	TransTypeID = 3 --star

IF @id IS NULL OR @id = '' OR @id = 'NULL'
	SET @id = CFG.GET_PARAM_VALUE('HIST_ID_FIELDNAME')

IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CFG.COLUMNS WHERE TableID = @TableID AND Column_Name = @id)
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM CFG.OLAP_PARTITIONS WHERE TableID = @TableID
	SELECT 
		@schema = S.Schema_Name,
		@table = T.Table_Name 
	FROM 
		CFG.TABLES T
		INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
			S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
	WHERE 
		T.TableID = @TableID

	SET @cur = @min

	WHILE @cur <= @max
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO CFG.OLAP_PARTITIONS(Name, TableID, SQL)
		SELECT @table + '_' + CONVERT(varchar(8), @I),  @TableID, 'SELECT * FROM ['+ @schema + '].[' + @table + '] WHERE ' + 
		CASE WHEN @cur <> @min THEN @id + ' > ' + CONVERT(varchar(12), @cur) ELSE '' END + 
		CASE WHEN @cur <> @min AND @cur + @step <= @max  THEN  ' AND ' ELSE '' END + 
		CASE WHEN @cur + @step <= @max  THEN  @id + ' <= ' + CONVERT(varchar(12), @cur + @step) ELSE '' END 

		SET @I = @I + 1
		SET @cur = @cur + @step
	END
END
